leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement TypeScript interfaces to define prop types for Vue components
Apply prop type validation using the `defineProps` function with TypeScript
Construct reusable component interfaces with required and optional properties
Configure default values for optional props while maintaining type safety
Update existing components to use TypeScript interfaces for prop validation
Bind component props to interface-defined types in template expressions
Integrate TypeScript interfaces across multiple components in a Vue application
